subject: Control evidence request: IAM artifacts for SIG review
messages:
From: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@finsecure.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: security-portal@finsecure.com
Date: Fri, 03 Oct 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Control evidence request: IAM artifacts for SIG review

Hi Rishi,

Thanks for taking this — FinSecure's external SIG review is scheduled for the week of Oct 12 and our assessor has requested a focused bundle of IAM control artifacts to validate SSO/SAML, SCIM provisioning, delegated admin controls and role/principle of least privilege. Specifically we need: 
- SAML assertion samples (at least 3, covering user, service account, and admin flows)
- SCIM delta export showing provisioning/deprovisioning events for the last 30 days
- RBAC role matrix and owner mapping (service accounts included)
- Evidence of privileged access reviews / JIT controls if available

Is it possible to deliver these as a single archive or secure upload by EOD Oct 5? We can accept via our secure portal (link below) or SFTP.

Secure upload: https://secure-upload.finsecure.com/upload/AB12CD34

Appreciate it — Maria
Security Assurance, FinSecure

Attachments: none
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@finsecure.com>
Cc: naomi_feldman@redwood.ai, jordan_blake@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 03 Oct 2026 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Control evidence request: IAM artifacts for SIG review

Maria —

Thanks for the clear list. We can deliver everything you've asked for by EOD Oct 5. Internal owners below — tagging so responsibilities are clear: 
- Naomi Feldman: SCIM delta export & deprovisioning trace (naomi to produce CSV + event log)
- Jordan Blake: SAML assertion samples + short explanation of assertion mapping (Jordan to gather examples and redact PII)
- Marissa Cole: RBAC role matrix and service-account mapping + privileged access review notes

I'll compile the artifacts into a single encrypted archive and upload to your secure portal. Can you confirm the portal link above is the one you want us to use? Also, do you need signed timestamps or audit-chain notes for the SCIM snapshot?

Rishi
Director, Security Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Folks — quick status: I'm pulling three SAML assertion samples from our test harness and will scrub attributes that identify end-users. Deliverables I will produce:
- redwood_saml_assertion_samples.txt (3 assertions; user/admin/service-account)
- brief mapping doc (plain text) that shows how NameID, eduPersonAffiliation, and roles are mapped into our app RBAC

Jordan

Attachments referenced: saml-assertion-template.txt (internal)
From: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@finsecure.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: security-portal@finsecure.com
Date: Sun, 04 Oct 2026 11:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Control evidence request: IAM artifacts for SIG review

Rishi / team —

Yes, the secure-upload link is correct. Two small clarifications from the assessor: 
1) Please include at least one proof of delegated-admin configuration showing an admin role that is scoped (not global), and an audit of any admin role changes in the last 60 days.
2) If you have a short note describing your least-privilege review cadence (quarterly / triggered by onboarding/offboarding), please include that as a one-pager (bullet list is fine).

No need for DocuSign for these artifacts; upload is fine. Thanks for the quick turnaround — we will flag any follow-ups after review.

—Maria

Attachments: none
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@finsecure.com>, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: jordan_blake@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 09:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Control evidence request: IAM artifacts for SIG review

Maria —

Attached (uploaded to your secure portal) is the artifact bundle per the checklist. Summary below and files included in the upload. Let me know if you need hashes or signed timestamps.

Summary of what's been uploaded to https://secure-upload.finsecure.com/upload/AB12CD34:
- redwood_saml_assertion_samples.txt — three redacted SAML assertions (user, admin, service-account)
- scim_delta_snapshot_20261004.csv — SCIM delta export (30 days) with event_type, timestamp, actor, target_id, changes
- rbac_role_matrix_redwood.xlsx — role -> permission matrix with owner (sheets: application_roles, service_accounts)
- service_account_mapping_sample.csv — sample mapping of service accounts to owners and purpose
- privileged_access_review_notes.txt — one-pager on quarterly review cadence and JIT controls
- delegated_admin_change_log_60d.csv — audit of admin role changes (last 60 days)

Notes: 
- We've redacted end-user PII in the SAML samples; we left assertion attributes required by the assessor (NameID pseudonymized, role attributes intact).
- If you want SHA256 checksums for the files, I can include them in a follow-up.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Security Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_saml_assertion_samples.txt; scim_delta_snapshot_20261004.csv; rbac_role_matrix_redwood.xlsx; service_account_mapping_sample.csv; delegated_admin_change_log_60d.csv; privileged_access_review_notes.txt
